statements.statement: An article for additional Chapter 70 funding to schools is already on the fall town meeting warrant, but the town manager has heard no need for the money and is not inclined to transfer it.
A prior Town Meeting warrant article funded partial repair of the TCP roof, over the section of the building being decommissioned.
The facilities director's full estimate, including contingency, to replace the entire TCP roof rather than repair it in sections.
The School Committee reported a budget surplus compared to previous estimates, discussed at a community Q&A on the budget and overage.

warnings.condition: if the roof is repaired in pieces rather than as one full project
warnings.prediction: Repairing the TCP roof in sections risks a 'jigsaw' effect from seam lines between differently-aged roof areas, potentially causing future issues.
